name: WebGL parameters and extensions
plain: About 65 WebGL limits and an extension list that differ by GPU and driver.
meaning: MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE (4096 to 32768), MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS, shader precision formats and supported extensions together fingerprint the GPU even when the renderer string is hidden.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can measure about 65 graphics limits that point to your GPU and driver
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when a page draws 3D graphics or tests for it

Tell GPU and driver families apart

story.what_it_is: About 65 graphics limits and a list of extras that differ by graphics chip and driver.

marketing.name: WebGL API
marketing.pitch: Docs describe WebGL as the way pages draw fast 2D and 3D graphics in the browser.

story.for_you: You never see it. A 3D game or map asks your graphics chip what it can do and picks settings that work. The same answers, taken together, can act as a fingerprint of your graphics hardware.
story.for_makers: Graphics apps must know the biggest texture, the shader precision and which extras exist. Trackers read the same numbers because they differ by chip and driver. Even when the name is hidden, the limits can tell devices apart.

use_cases.example: A browser 3D game reads the texture size limit and picks high or medium graphics so it does not crash.
A web map asks which graphics features exist to draw 3D buildings smoothly.
A browser 3D tool checks which extensions exist before turning on advanced lighting.
A cloud gaming page uses graphics capability to tune its overlay and video drawing.
A web based virtual tour scales scene detail to what the graphics chip can handle.
A fraud service uses the limit list to tell real GPUs from virtual machines and emulators.
A fingerprint vendor adds the graphics profile to a device ID that survives cookie clearing.

risks: Works even if the GPU name is hidden

linkedin.how: 65+ parameters. Read by the LinkedIn APFC fingerprint script (48 features, alleged by BrowserGate, partly confirmed by BleepingComputer).
